summary: @servicetitan/testing-library preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (pinned to 1.3.13), extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, sets it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (rotated string-array indirection, a large numeric/string constant pool, and a custom-alphabet string decoder) whose contents cannot be validated by inspection. Under a normal `npm install`, the alien runtime is fetched and used to execute the obfuscated bundle automatically. Fetching a second language runtime solely to run an obfuscated sibling script at preinstall is inconsistent with a React testing helper's stated purpose, and the payload's actual behavior is concealed from Node-oriented review by both the obfuscation and the choice of runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
